old_problem: DeepSeek changes the explicit denominator from 100 to five, uses an unproven chassis power-cycle reset class and treats AER count as a proxy for PCIe, MCTP, SSIF and FPGA stability. The earlier record also left the guide revision and exact interface oracles as an Engineering Decision rather than runtime Project Configuration.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict under ED-06/ED-14/ED-16/ED-18/ED-29. The test uses the same powered OS warm-reset boundary established for SY.2, executes exactly 100 accounted cycles, and never substitutes BMC chassis OFF/ON. The named interface manifests and guide revision are fail-closed Project Configuration. A five-cycle run is optional preflight only. Immutable per-cycle evidence and halt-on-first-anomaly preserve the reliability signal without automatic retry.
decision_basis: The exact XLSX row 1926, same-row tests.json/DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record and ED-01 through ED-30 were read; the actual next queue row was opened as Functionality 1927 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00010-V002 / f170a524def42114.
ED-14 forbids a short smoke test from replacing a required long-duration run; the denominator stays exactly 100 completed warm cycles.
ED-06 separates warm from DC/AC. Each cycle is an approved OS-initiated reboot with independent proof chassis power stayed ON and Boot ID/OS Ready changed.
PCIe, MCTP, SSIF and FPGA are distinct protocols/identities. Each gets a versioned expected manifest and direct health transaction; OS boot or AER count cannot proxy them.

The runner atomically records cycle index, reset/boot timeline and complete results before advancing, then stops on the first missing endpoint, error or recovery degradation; reruns cannot erase failure.
No reboot, power, protocol, SSH, log, recovery, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: 100-cycle powered warm-reboot endurance with OS, PCIe, MCTP, SSIF and FPGA recovery
test_case.purpose: Complete exactly 100 approved OS warm reboots without chassis power loss and prove every cycle returns to OS Ready with stable complete PCIe, MCTP, SSIF and FPGA identity/communication plus acceptable platform health.
required_package: Exact SUT/firmware/OS identity, approved GB300 NVL72 guide revision and supported OS warm-reboot interface
Approved 100-cycle window, workload/storage quiescence, boot/inter-cycle timeouts and independent console/BMC recovery
Expected PCIe BDF/device/link, MCTP endpoint/EID/route, SSIF request/response and FPGA identity/version/status manifests
Complete per-cycle AER/DPC/kernel/BMC/storage/thermal/power limits and sufficient immutable evidence storage
Secure authenticated runner with atomic 1-100 ledger, halt policy, no automatic retry and owner approval
test_case.test_command: REQUIRES CONFIRMATION; validate the exact guide, warm-reset class, endpoint manifests, workload drain, recovery and evidence capacity. Capture complete baseline. For cycle 1 through 100, atomically open a unique ledger entry; invoke only the approved OS warm-reboot action; independently prove chassis remains ON, Boot ID changes and the same target reaches OS Ready; collect and compare complete PCIe/link, MCTP endpoint/route, SSIF transaction, FPGA identity/status and full error/health windows; hash/close the entry before advancing. Halt on the first anomaly and never auto-retry or silently resume. A five-cycle preflight is labeled SMOKE ONLY and does not reduce the 100-cycle denominator. Do not use chassis power cycle, fixed sleep, plaintext credentials, disabled host verification or truncated logs.
test_case.expected_result: Ledger entries 1-100 each prove a powered warm reset, boot transition and OS Ready within limits, with every expected PCIe function/link, MCTP endpoint/route, SSIF transaction and FPGA identity/status stable and all error/storage/thermal/power evidence within approved policy. No cycle is missing, duplicated, substituted or hidden by retry.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exactly 100 complete unique cycles and every per-cycle reset-class, boot, endpoint, protocol and health criterion. Five-cycle smoke, 99 cycles, uptime/AER-only evidence or a DC/AC cycle cannot PASS. FAIL on any first boot timeout, wrong reset class, missing/downtrained PCIe device, MCTP/SSIF/FPGA mismatch, AER/DPC, storage/data, thermal/power fault, ledger gap or retry censorship. NOT READY applies when guide/oracles/window/recovery are absent; end user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Require long-window maintenance approval, workload/write drain, evidence capacity and independent recovery before cycle 1.
Use only powered OS warm reboot; stop if chassis OFF, rail loss or other cycle class appears.
Persist complete first-failure evidence and stop; never automatically reboot, retry, skip or overwrite a failed cycle.
Use verified secure access; preserve logs and abort on boot, endpoint, data, thermal, power or recovery anomaly.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant, target/firmware/OS, guide revision, warm command/class and approved 100-cycle plan
Immutable atomic ledger 1-100 with command audit, Boot IDs, console/BMC power and OS Ready timeline
Per-cycle normalized PCIe/link, MCTP/EID/route, SSIF transaction and FPGA identity/version/status comparisons
Per-cycle complete AER/DPC/kernel/BMC/storage/thermal/power windows and first-failure preservation
100/100 completeness calculation, no-smoke-substitution/no-auto-retry audit, final health, workload restore and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On the first wrong reset class, boot timeout, endpoint/protocol mismatch, error, data, thermal, power or access anomaly, stop and seal that cycle's evidence. Do not issue another reboot or retry. Keep workloads stopped; use only the approved independent console/BMC recovery runbook, reconcile platform health and obtain owner disposition before any separately authorized continuation. A resumed or rerun cycle remains visibly linked to the original failure and cannot replace it.
